_readme.description: PHW Denial Intake — Workflow 1 of 3 (Updated: multi-entity, multi-payer, scan intake, duplicate detection)
_readme.overview: Three intake paths: (A) DrChrono ERA/835 polling 2x/day, (B) Google Drive scan-and-drop for paper denials, (C) Manual webhook fallback. All paths converge at Entity Lookup → Duplicate Check → Monday.com creation. Handles unknown payers and unknown denial codes by routing to Manual Review.
setup_steps: 1. Import this workflow into your n8n instance
2. Configure Google Cloud credentials (Vertex AI + Drive/Docs)
3. Configure Monday.com HTTP Header Auth credential
4. Configure DrChrono HTTP Header Auth credential
6. Set Google Drive folder IDs: GOOGLE_DRIVE_DENIAL_INBOX_ID, GOOGLE_DRIVE_PROCESSED_DENIALS_ID, GOOGLE_DRIVE_FAILED_DENIALS_ID
7. Set ENTITIES_CONFIG env var with JSON array from config/entities.json
8. Create 3 new Monday.com columns: text_mm0gr7ga, text_mm0gv12z, text_mm0gw2sh
9. Create Google Drive folders: Denial Inbox, Processed Denials, Failed Denials

intake_paths.path_a: DrChrono ERA/835 — Cron polls 2x/day (8 AM, 4 PM) for denied line items
intake_paths.path_b: Google Drive scan — Staff drops scanned PDF/image into Denial Inbox folder
intake_paths.path_c: Manual webhook — Fallback when scan fails, POST to /phw-denial-intake
